content.text: Goa Institute of Management has evolved into one of India’s premier B-schools. It has blended academic rigour with real-world scenarios to deliver holistic perspectives to its students, honing agile leaders through an industry-forward curriculum. Its programmes go beyond an emphasis on business acumen, focusing on sustainability and adaptability in a fast-paced world, and draw students from diverse backgrounds. Goa Institute of Management celebrated the much-anticipated Convocation 2026, on March 28, 2026. The event honoured 617 graduate students, capping off their rigorous academic journeys in management programmes. They were awarded their degrees by Ashank Desai, Chairperson, Board of Governors, and Prof. Ajit Parulekar, Director, GIM. Sunil Gupta, Co-Founder, Managing Director and CEO, Yotta Data Services, was the Chief Guest of the Convocation ceremony. Sunil Gupta is popularly known as the 'Data Centre Man of India,’ and is at the forefront of India's data center and artificial intelligence (AI) revolutions. An alumnus of Columbia University and NIT Kurukshetra, Sunil's 30+ year industry tenure is marked by visionary leadership and relentless innovation, significantly advancing India’s digital infrastructure and AI capabilities.Ashank Desai, Chairperson, Board of Governors, said, “As a graduate of Goa Institute of Management, what will set you apart is how you think, collaborate, and respond to unforeseen challenges of the future. As you step into diverse roles and industries, I encourage you to stay grounded in your values and take ownership of the impact you create. We, at GIM, take pride in shaping individuals who can lead with purpose, and I am confident you will carry that forward in everything you do.”Prof. Ajit Parulekar, Director, opines, “GIMGIM is continuously strengthening its commitment to academic excellence, innovation, and industry relevance. In the past one year, we have focused on enhancing our programmes and creating an environment that encourages critical thinking and responsible leadership. As our graduating class steps into the professional world, they are well-equipped with the knowledge, skills, and values needed to navigate complexity and drive positive change across sectors.”Sunil Gupta, Co-Founder, Managing Director and CEO, Yotta Data Services, stated, “I extend my best wishes to the graduating class. As you enter a world defined by rapid technological changes, remember that your success will not be determined solely by knowledge; rather, it will be determined by your ability to adapt, learn continuously, and make purpose-driven decisions. As graduates of Goa Institute of Management, you carry with you the responsibility to lead with empathy, think boldly, and create meaningful impact across industries and society. I am sure that each of you will contribute to shaping a more sustainable future.” Watch GIM Convocation 2026: Marking Milestones, Shaping TomorrowDetails of the graduating cohort ProgrammeNumber of graduating studentsPost Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)280PGDM - Big Data Analytics172PGDM - Banking, Insurance and Financial Services61PGDM - Healthcare Management57PGDM - Hybrid44Fellowship Program in Management (FPM)03In addition, the Institute awarded 13 gold and 2 silver medals across different academic categories during the event. The Institute continues its legacy as a premier institution shaping future business leaders and driving advancements in management education.GIM’s Convocation 2026 is a reflection of the institute’s commitment to resilience, collaboration, and vision. Beyond the celebrations, GIM’s convocation showcases the institute’s focus on 360-degree development of professionals and aligning the curriculum with global needs such as inclusive business models and environmental stewardship. This attention enables graduates to navigate a complex world of business from action-packed boardrooms to startup ecosystems, contributing to India’s economic narrative.
